value.rationale: The sharp discontinuous topology of the relaxation-crossing phase diagram (an isolated resonance plus a disjoint oscillatory-dominance interval) and logarithmic divergence of the number of transient crossings are motivated by a natural two-stage recovery clock. The precise threshold separates observable memory cancellation from ordinary complex-eigenvalue dominance, enabling quantitative diagnosis of slow finite-time relaxation. It is not a routine table entry, model renaming, or arbitrary parameter slice.
